entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Just need the return authorization.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I get your name or order number?
The order is under Sarah Jenkins. It's for the cycling shoes.

Okay, I see your account right here, Ms. Jenkins. Thank you for being one of our VIP members. I see the order for the cycling shoes. Just so I document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Listen, I don't have time for a full interview. They're uncomfortable and gave me blisters on the first ride. I couldn't even get the cleats set up right. I just want a refund. Yes or no, can you process the return?
Yes, absolutely. My apologies. I see the delivery was 22 days ago. Our policy for standard items is 90 days, so you're well within the return window. I'm processing the return for you right now.
Great. So you're emailing me the shipping label?

I've just sent it. The email with the prepaid label should be in your inbox. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method. And for the trouble with the blisters and as a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $20 credit to your account.
Oh. Okay, that's actually useful. I appreciate that. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Ms. Jenkins. Have a great day.
